title: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the… (CVE-2026-104920)
description: LibreOffice Calc allows linking a cell range to an external data source, with the link saved in the document. A vulnerability exists where opening a crafted document can cause a Java database driver to be loaded from a remote location outside the local machine, enabling execution of arbitrary code. This issue arises because the fix for a previous vulnerability (CVE-2026-63277) did not cover this attack vector. The fix requires that Java class path entries be file URLs pointing only to local files.
